verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI spec. The closest things are equivalents: MCP clients can programmatically load the full tool catalog with its schemas (mcpClient.tools()), and Pipedream publishes machine-readable llms.txt and per-app .md pages listing the endpoint and required headers. It also documents a REST API, but no spec file for it. missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec for the Connect REST API, documentation of where to fetch it, and independent corroboration.
